lines.text: After the emotional reunion,
Little Mermaid took everyone to the real ocean in a bubble.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It's beautiful.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Is this a place you created?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Ahhh...

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Amazing.
Cinderella and Grave stare at the bubble tree.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Wow, I never thought I'd be able to visit the ocean depths...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It's certainly easier on the eyes

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: than inside Gluttony's throat.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo!

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Is this all made from bubbles?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ohh!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It's because of Abe that I'm capable of all this.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: The past me?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh!

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I wonder how it was made.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Do you mind if I look into it?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'll tell you everything I know. Conduct as much research as you like.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Do you want to visit the bubble workshop?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Or would you rather go back to the bubbles?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: No, it's okay.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Hehe, they're both so beautiful.
Mori looks at Little Mermaid's face, and explains to Cinderella and Grave what she sees.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Look at her. She can't even conceal her joy.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: How could she have thought of dying inside Gluttony without meeting anyone, when she's that happy?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Are you jealous?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: That's not it!

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yuni also thinks you're jealous.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I said no!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: It's just...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: It's nice to see her happy.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: That's all.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Wow, Mori. I've never heard you speak so frankly.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo...!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I know how to say things like this, you know!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Of course I know.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Good grief...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'm right there with you, Mori.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'm glad that Siren is happy too.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: how long are you guys going to be staying here?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Until we have a chance to catch our breath, I suppose.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: And how long is that?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'd say a week at most.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I contacted Mana and told her everything was resolved,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: but I still need to meet with her and give a full report on what we learned here.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... And there's also someone else I have to report to about my body.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I guess that's when I'll head out as well.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hmm? Where'll you go?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Where else, you goof?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: The Ark.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Ah, that reminds me.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I have you to thank for me not getting scrapped.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Thank you, Mihara.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You heard about that?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Yes. I got a message from a certain someone.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: She congratulated me on the mission being a resounding success.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... Jien.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You've done me a huge favor, Mihara.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'll be sure to pay you back someday.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: At any rate, I'll be stuck in the Ark doing whatever comes my way,

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: but I'll find a way... somehow, to pay you back.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I appreciate the thought, Mori,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: but I don't think you're going to be at the Ark.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, never mind.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Now then,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: what do you say we start properly enjoying our vacation?

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Good point. Who knows when we'll get another chance like this?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: We need to take it all in.
Mori gazes beyond the bubbles, into the ocean where the golden sunlight is shining down.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: We mustn't forget that beautiful places like this exist.
Ensconced within a sea so beautiful that
it feels torn from a fairytale,
new friends introduce themselves to one another.
Meanwhile, old friends reminisce about past memories,
share stories of their time spent apart,
and laugh together.
Together, they write the first page of a new story.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I suppose

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: it's time for us to all part ways.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Mihara. Yuni.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Thank you for everything.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: If there ever comes a day when you need help,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'll come running.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, we should be the ones thanking you.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I hope we can see each other again someday.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'm sure we will.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: So long as we want to see each other,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I know that

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: we'll meet once again.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Definitely.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Let's meet again someday.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Hey, what's the big idea?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Why do you keep leaving me out of your goodbyes?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: It's kinda hard not to take it personally...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah uh?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'm leaving too.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: From now on, don't ever part from your friends.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Live together with them, and be well.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Don't foolishly try to throw your life away to save someone.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Not everyone is like you.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Be a little more cautious, okay?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Don't just stand there! Say something!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... Where are you going?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: The Ark, where else?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: What do you mean by "why"? It's the only place I have left to go.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Weren't you coming with me?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You said it while we were both trapped inside Gluttony.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That we'd both make it out of there alive, and write a happy ending together.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Don't you remember?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I-I remember!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I just thought we were talking about getting out of that Rapture...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You don't want to stay with me anymore?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: What? No! Of course I want to stay with you!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Are you sure that'd be okay?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You've seen for yourself how useless I am in battle.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: All I'm good for is

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: digging holes in the ground...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I barely have any survival skills either.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I don't really have anything that I'm good at.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'm fine with that.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I don't know the first thing about what it means to travel on the surface.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'll only drag you down.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Are you sure you're okay with that?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Aooh!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You might be okay with it, but what about your friends?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: As far as I'm concerned,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: you became one of us the moment you risked your life to save Siren.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: If Cinderella is okay with it, so am I.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You guys...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It's okay, Mori, really.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I've gotten to know you quite well.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You're thoughtful, smart, brave...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: And you're also my friend.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: So, I'll take your advice to heart.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: From now on, I won't live recklessly and put my life in jeopardy.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'll make sure my story has a happy ending.
Little Mermaid reaches out her hand to Mori.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Mori, will you stay with me?
Mori also reaches out and holds Little Mermaid's hand.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I... I will. I'd love to!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'd be honored to go with you guys.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Are you really sure that's okay?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: You're part of the team. Let's go together.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... Thank you.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, well, that worked out quite nicely, Mori.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo coo!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Mihara, Yuni...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I told you that you wouldn't be going back to the Ark, didn't I?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Guess you were right.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Well, put 'er there.
Mihara extends her hand.
Mori grasps Mihara's hand.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, I don't mind shaking your hand,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: but I meant to ask you for your phone again.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: My phone? Why?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You're not going back to the Ark, and choosing instead to travel with the Pilgrims.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: In other words, you're deserting the Ark.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You need to get rid of anything that could be used to track your location.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Ah, you're right.
Mori fumbles for her phone, then hands it over to Mihara.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... Thank you, Mihara.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Don't mention it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Take care of yourself, and make sure you're getting along with Siren out there.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: We'll meet again.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo oooh!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Yes, we will. I'm sure of it.
Yuni and Mihara turn around and walk toward the Ark.
Little Mermaid and Mori watch their figures grow smaller and smaller
until they disappear against the horizon,
all the while wishing and hoping they'll meet again someday.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Well, we ought to get going as well.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Before we go back to Prince, I'd like to meet up with Hansel and Gretel if possible.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Siren.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Do you know where Hansel and Gretel are?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Did something happen to them?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: If you're intent on fighting alongside Hansel and Gretel,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: then perhaps... it might be better not to go looking for them.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What? Whatever do you mean?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hansel and Gretel...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: are no longer on humanity's side.
